findings.quoted_text: Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.
Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.
Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.
findings.explanation: Your liability under the agreement is completely unlimited, exposing you to severe financial risk if a claim is brought against you.
findings.suggested_change: The total aggregate liability of Contractor arising out of or related to this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable by Client under this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.
findings.explanation: Your payment is conditional upon the client receiving payment from its own customer, which creates an indefinite delay risk if their customer fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a couple of minor adjustments before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause on liability, the agreement currently leaves liability unlimited, which creates unnecessary exposure. I propose updating it so that the total aggregate liability is limited to the total fees paid or payable by the client under this agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment terms, making payment conditional on receiving funds from your own customer creates an indefinite delay. I propose changing this so that invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt. Thank you for considering these changes. Best regards,
